star.name: Ayo Dosunmu
lines: 3 driving layups late in the third

story: Down 11 early in the second, Minnesota went on a 26–6 run, led by 23 and held off Memphis, 104–95.
aria: Animated Short: Ayo Dosunmu's driving layup with 21 seconds left in the third quarter that made it 83–62, capping a stretch of 14 of the quarter's last 16 points for the Timberwolves. Timberwolves win 104–95. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
